next_steps: Build the chronological all-market account/input adapter. Join as-of token pairs, reward minima, spread/tick metadata, books and public prints. Generate entries from resting V4-style quotes. Track paired inventory, outstanding entry-order cancellation, additional fills, and resumption after flat. Preserve the full universe-to-usable-input funnel. Force-farming research uses independently funded exposures; final whole-bot replay uses the agreed shared capital budget.

Qualify fee calculation against recorded market schedules at each execution price. The older V4 replay explicitly used a zero-fee sensitivity assumption; that is not sufficient for net-loss results. Unknown fees must remain unknown.

Freeze a real recorded entry cohort and run a bounded actual-data canary, then longer matched experiments with complete and censored episodes visible. Final trajectory replay must allow downtime to change subsequent fills, rather than force identical later entries on all policies.

Reconstruct comparable farmer episodes from retained evidence. Implement retrospective observed-action comparisons separately from causal decoded rules. No real farmer episode or decoded Kappa policy is claimed yet.

limitations: First three-hour batch: every qualifying entry under the declared recorded HTTP-depth/observed-print model, without an arbitrary episode cap. This is not proof of complete venue or trade coverage.
Every rule starts with the same 82 episodes and 2,839.8484 shares. Open positions survive the cutoff and continue in later batches; no forced batch-end exit.

Dollars cover only fully exited, fee-known episodes paired with immediate exit on the same entries. Different rules have different completed subsets; open positions and partial exits are excluded from dollar totals. Negative completed loss is not whole-cohort profit.

Independent saved-fill arithmetic verified all 21 rows, common shares, conservation, time bounds and source hashes. Raw entry eligibility, the complete market funnel and every policy decision were not independently rerun.

Uses recorded HTTP depth and observed WS trade prints, V4 minimum-size base quotes, proportional touch fills, full strict-through fills and zero modeled cancellation delay. WS depth changes are not reconstructed. Missing/stale books stop new fills.

Independently funded common-entry lots, not shared-capital whole-bot P&L. Fees use recorded schedules without per-match rounding. Missed rewards are excluded; R020 has the same active recovery/deadline behavior as R010.
Preliminary results only: no winning-rule, profitability, complete-coverage or live-readiness conclusion.
preliminary.status: Recorded batch; saved execution arithmetic verified; preliminary model

mutations.name: Quick reset
mutations.description: Hold 5 minutes, then exit.

mutations.name: Short pause
mutations.description: Hold 15 minutes, then exit.

mutations.name: Half-hour reset
mutations.description: Hold 30 minutes, then exit.

mutations.name: One-hour recovery window
mutations.description: Hold 1 hour, then exit.

mutations.name: Two-hour recovery window
mutations.description: Hold 2 hours, then exit.

mutations.name: Patient four-hour window
mutations.description: Hold 4 hours, then exit.

mutations.name: Extended six-hour window
mutations.description: Hold 6 hours, then exit.

mutations.name: Scratch after fees
mutations.description: Exit when the complete position can break even after fees; otherwise 6 hours.

mutations.name: Recover one quarter
mutations.description: Exit after recovering 25% of the immediate-exit loss; otherwise 4 hours.

mutations.name: Recover one half
mutations.description: Exit after recovering 50% of the immediate-exit loss; otherwise 4 hours.

mutations.name: Recover three quarters
mutations.description: Exit after recovering 75% of the immediate-exit loss; otherwise 6 hours.

mutations.name: Relax the recovery target
mutations.description: Require 75% recovery in hour 1, 50% in hour 2, then 25%; exit by 4 hours.

mutations.name: Confirm the recovery
mutations.description: Require 50% recovery on at least 3 distinct books spanning 60 seconds; exit by 4 hours. Gaps reset confirmation.

mutations.name: Protect a rebound
mutations.description: Arm after 50% recovery; exit if loss worsens from its best by 25% of initial loss. Exit by 6 hours.

mutations.name: Scratch or cut deterioration
mutations.description: Exit at break-even or when loss reaches 150% of the immediate-exit loss; otherwise 2 hours.

mutations.name: Leave a stalled recovery
mutations.description: Exit after 1 continuously observed hour without an improvement of at least 5% of initial loss; otherwise 4 hours. Gaps reset the stall clock.

mutations.name: Exit a fading rebound
mutations.description: After 50% recovery, exit on 3 consecutive worsening fresh books; otherwise 4 hours. Gaps reset the sequence.

mutations.name: Halve risk, then recover
mutations.description: Sell half immediately. Exit the rest when combined loss is at most 50% of the immediate-exit loss; otherwise 4 hours.

mutations.name: Four-step exit
mutations.description: Sell cumulative 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% at 15, 30, 60, 120 minutes, limited by available depth.

mutations.name: Cap the reward sacrifice
mutations.description: Exit after 50% recovery or when missed rewards reach 25% of the initial loss; otherwise 4 hours. Unknown rewards cannot trigger the budget rule.

trigger: Every farming fill leaving unpaired inventory
